name: eval_eq_true
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_eq_true {x : ι → G} : eval x = true ↔ ∑ i, x i = 0

name: trivial_of_isForbiddenPattern_of_isValid_eval
statement:
lemma trivial_of_isForbiddenPattern_of_isValid_eval (ha : IsForbiddenPattern a)
    (hP : P.IsValid eval t) (hE : ∀ i, eval (a i) = true) (hB : ∀ i, P.broadcast (a i) t = B) :
    ∀ i j, a i = a j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, ha⟩ := ha
  have : P.broadcast v t = B := ha.broadcast_eq hB
  have h i : eval (a i) = eval v :=
    calc
      _ = P.guess i (forget i (a i)) (P.broadcast (a i) t) := by rw [hP]
      _ = P.guess i (forget i v) (P.broadcast v t) := by rw [hB, ha.broadcast_eq hB, ha.forget]
      _ = eval v := by rw [hP]
  suffices h : ∀ i, a i = v by simp [h]
  intro i
  ext j
  obtain hij | rfl := ne_or_eq i j
  · exact ha hij
  simp only [hE, Bool.true_eq, eval_eq_true, forall_const] at h
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    a i i - v i = ∑ j, (a i j - v j) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single]; simpa [eq_comm, sub_eq_zero] using @ha i
    _ = ∑ j, a i j - ∑ j, v j := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = 0 := by simpa [h] using hE i

name: broadcast_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma broadcast_zero (P : Protocol G d) (x : ZMod d → G) : broadcast P x 0 = []

name: broadcast_succ
statement:
lemma broadcast_succ (P : Protocol G d) (x : ZMod d → G) (t : ℕ) :
    broadcast P x (t + 1)
      = P.nextBit t (forget (t : ZMod d) x) (broadcast P x t) :: broadcast P x t

name: length_broadcast
statement:
@[simp]
lemma length_broadcast (P : Protocol G d) (x : ZMod d → G) : ∀ t, (broadcast P x t).length = t
  | 0 => rfl
  | t + 1 => by simpa [broadcast_succ] using length_broadcast _ _ _

noncomputable
def complexity (P : Protocol G d) (F : (ZMod d → G) → Bool) : ENat
proof:
:=
  ⨅ (t : ℕ) (_ : IsValid P F t), t

name: le_complexity
statement: @[simp] lemma le_complexity : t ≤ Protocol.complexity P F ↔ ∀ r : ℕ, P.IsValid F r → t ≤ r

name: le_funComplexity
statement: @[simp] lemma le_funComplexity : t ≤ funComplexity F ↔ ∀ P : Protocol G d, t ≤ P.complexity F

name: IsForbiddenPatternWithTip.broadcast_eq
statement:
lemma IsForbiddenPatternWithTip.broadcast_eq (hF : IsForbiddenPatternWithTip a v)
    (hB : ∀ i, P.broadcast (a i) t = B) : P.broadcast v t = B
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing B with
  | zero => simpa using hB 0
  | succ t ih =>
  simp_rw [Protocol.broadcast_succ] at *
  obtain _ | ⟨b, B⟩ := B
  · cases hB 0
  simp only [List.cons.injEq, forall_and] at hB
  specialize ih hB.2
  subst ih
  have h₁ : forget (t : ZMod d) v = forget (t : ZMod d) (a t) := hF.forget t
  have h₂ : P.broadcast v t = P.broadcast (a t) t := (hB.2 t).symm
  rw [h₁, h₂, hB.1]

name: isForbiddenPatternWithTip_iff_forget
statement:
lemma isForbiddenPatternWithTip_iff_forget :
    IsForbiddenPatternWithTip a v ↔ ∀ i, forget i v = forget i (a i)

name: isMultidimCorner_forget_of_isForbiddenPattern
statement:
lemma isMultidimCorner_forget_of_isForbiddenPattern (a : ι → ι → G) (h : IsForbiddenPattern a)
    (hS : ∀ i, ∑ j, a i j = 0) (i : ι) :
    IsMultidimCorner (fun j ↦ forget i (a j)) (forget i (a i))
proof:
:= by
    rw [IsForbiddenPattern] at h
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
    refine ⟨fun k l ↦ ?_, fun k l hneq ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [← sub_eq_zero]
      calc
        ∑ j : {j // j ≠ i}, a k j - ∑ j : { j // j ≠ i }, a l j
          = ∑ j : {j // j ≠ i}, (a k j - a l j) := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = ∑ j ∈ {i}ᶜ, (a k j - a l j) := (Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) (a k - a l)).symm
        _ = ∑ j ∈ {i}ᶜ, (a k j - a l j) + (a k i - a l i) := by simp [hv k.2, hv l.2]
        _ = ∑ j : ι, (a k j - a l j) := by rw [← Fintype.sum_eq_sum_compl_add]
        _ = 0 := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_eq_zero, hS k, hS l]
    · rw [forget, forget, hv, hv l.2.symm]
      aesop
